title: placement_set
description: Instances of other documents, each with a transform and what it shows. No content of its own.

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, by its `$id`: the last path segment names the file in husk's schema/ directory, and schema_version says which version of it (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "The contract header").

schema_version.description: Version of the schema this document conforms to.

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

provenance.description: Who wrote it, when, from what.

definition.description: A placement set defines nothing beyond its instances.

selection.description: A placement set selects nothing; each instance carries its own selection.

references.description: Other documents this one depends on.

id.description: The instance's id, stable within the set: a tile's or WDT's placement uniqueId, a map volume's or zone light's own id, a WMO doodad's MODD index, else a count husk assigns in placement order. It is how a runtime addresses, moves or deletes the instance and how a saved layout names it again; uniqueIds are map-wide, so the same id in two sets of one world is one object to load once.

reference.description: The id of the placed model's or effect's reference.

anchor.description: A joint of the model that owns the set: the instance moves with it. Its translation stays in that model's frame at the bind pose. Absent: the set's frame.

translation.description: Position in the set's parent frame; the frame's origin for a record that states no position. Transforms are local to the parent frame, never a pre-composed world matrix, so sets nest and a consumer composes the chain at runtime (REFACTOR/PLACEMENT_SETS.md invariant 3).

rotation.description: Orientation in the set's parent frame; identity for a record that states none.

scale.description: Uniform scale; 1 for a record that states none.

tint.description: A WMO doodad's colour, the light sampled at its authored spot. It goes stale once the instance moves, and is kept labelled rather than dropped: a runtime may recompute it or ignore it.

multiplier.description: Intensity factor; 1 when the WMO has no multipliers.

distant.description: Present when the source lists the instance for drawing at range (a terrain tile's distant-object list); a renderer drawing the tile from afar leaves out every instance without it. Whether the list was read at all is the tile's provenance (source obj1).

bounds_min.description: Minimum of the placed, transformed model's box, in the set's parent frame.

radius.description: The source's radius for the listing; the client's distance culling scales with it (wowdev), by a rule not established.

band.description: Which of the source's three bands lists the instance, absent when the source has no bands; what a band means is not established.

selection.description: What the placed model shows, indexing the placed model's own definition.

placement_sets.description: The placed model's owned sets shown beyond its always-on ones: indices into its definition.placement_sets, the WMO doodad sets a map object turns on (MWDR/MWDS already resolved); empty for any other instance.

items.description: A set of the placed model.

name_set.description: Which names the placed model's parts carry here: picks, in each part of its definition, the areas[] entry whose name_set equals it, since one building placed in two towns carries two names. Present on every map object, absent on any other instance.

inputs.description: A placed effect's inputs by name: only the names the effect declares, each of its declared kind.

priority.description: A placed effect's priority; absent: not stated.

provenance.description: A placed effect's derived or authored values.

unresolved.description: A placed effect's source values whose meaning is not known yet.

flags.description: The source's placement flags, or a placed effect's record flags; 0 for a record that has none.

record.description: The source record a placed effect was decoded from.

resources.description: Data the instances use by id.

textures.description: Every texture an instance input uses, each once.

light_params.description: Every light parameter set an instance's zone_light style uses, each once.
